lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚捧着纸袋走到窗口边，埃莉诺拎着空布袋跟在后面。
lines.en: Lydia comes to the window holding a paper bag, Eleanor following with an empty cloth bag.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这条巷子居然要绕三个弯，害我差点走错路口。
lines.en: This alley takes three turns? I almost took the wrong corner.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 明明是你半路非要先拐去逛布店，害我在巷口干等。
lines.en: You're the one who insisted on detouring to the fabric shop and left me waiting at the alley mouth.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好不容易下来看望索菲娅阿姨，我总不能空着手登门吧？
lines.en: I finally came down to visit Aunt Sophia. I can't show up empty-handed, can I?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 老板，店里有什么适合拿去拜访长辈的甜食吗？
lines.en: Shopkeeper, any sweets suitable for visiting an elder?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 第三层架子上。
lines.en: Third shelf.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 噗，他平时跟你待在一块也这么惜字如金吗？
lines.en: Pfft, is he this sparing with words when he's with you too?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 才没有呢，他平时跟我说话可从来不省字数。
lines.en: Not at all. He never skimps on words when he talks to me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不过今天这衣领真利整，折印一看就是指尖按出来的。
lines.en: His collar's so neat today, though. That crease was clearly pressed in by someone's fingertips.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你看你的糖盒去，少盯着别人的衣领乱瞄。
lines.en: Go look at your candy tins. Stop eyeing other people's collars.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （隔窗伸手又把你的衣领摁了一下）这里刚才明明还有点翘边。
lines.en: (Reaches through the window and presses your collar down again) This was sticking up just now.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 挑完喊我。
lines.en: Call me when you've picked.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 喂，你们俩到底打算什么时候彻底定下来呀？
lines.en: Hey, when are you two finally going to make it official?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 定什么定，他都还没正式开口呢。
lines.en: Official what? He hasn't even properly asked yet.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 再说了，我眼下也一点都不着急。
lines.en: Besides, I'm in no hurry right now.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 是吗，那上回是谁写信一页纸里提了他整整七趟？
lines.en: Oh really? Then who mentioned him seven times on one page last letter?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （急忙伸手去捂莉迪亚的嘴）嘘，你小声点行不行！
lines.en: (Hurriedly covers Lydia's mouth) Shh, keep your voice down!

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他就站在柜台里面，全都要被你嚷嚷听见了。
lines.en: He's right behind the counter. He'll hear every word you're shouting.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 行啦我不逗你了，还是先挑正经礼物要紧。
lines.en: Fine, I'll stop teasing. Picking a proper gift comes first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这盒硬糖留给埃莉诺解馋，软糖带去给索菲娅阿姨。
lines.en: The hard candy's for Eleanor's sweet tooth, the soft candy for Aunt Sophia.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 既然是买去孝敬我母亲的，干嘛还顺带扯上我？
lines.en: If it's a gift for my mother, why drag me into it?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 谁让某人从以前就一直惦记着这一口脆硬糖呢。
lines.en: Because a certain someone's always had a thing for crunchy hard candy.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 就这两盒？
lines.en: Just these two?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对，老板你按店里的实价给我算清楚就行。
lines.en: Yes. Just charge me the shop's real price.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 可千万别看在埃莉诺的面子上故意给我少收钱。
lines.en: And don't give me a discount for Eleanor's sake.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他做买卖向来有分寸，哪用得着你特意叮嘱。
lines.en: He always knows what he's doing. No need to tell him.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 数额算得这么痛快，埃莉诺看人的眼光确实不错。
lines.en: Such a clean, quick tally. Eleanor really does have a good eye for people.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 少在窗口贫嘴了，拎上你的糖袋赶紧走吧。
lines.en: Stop chattering at the window. Grab your candy and go.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，这个数额明显比平时便宜了一截吧？
lines.en: Oh my, that's quite a bit cheaper than usual, isn't it?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 就当是谢你大老远绕路过来，让你占回便宜好了。
lines.en: Call it thanks for coming all this way. Enjoy the bargain.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那这份人情我可就大大方方记下了。
lines.en: Then I'll happily owe you one.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 咦，今天这几盒糖的要价怎么比我预想的偏高一点？
lines.en: Huh, why are these candies pricier today than I expected?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 居然敢多收她的钱，等晚上关门我再找你算账。
lines.en: You dared overcharge her? We'll settle this after closing tonight.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 没买成甜食总不好空手登门，我再去别家铺子看看吧。
lines.en: I can't show up empty-handed without sweets. I'll try another shop.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 不用折腾去别家了，屋里备好茶点了你人到了就行。
lines.en: Don't bother with another shop. Tea and snacks are ready. Just come.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 打烊前，埃莉诺绕到窗外将手肘支在柜台沿上。
lines.en: Before closing, Eleanor comes around outside the window and props her elbows on the counter's edge.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲已经睡下了，床头小灯旁还摊着那几页研究笔记。
lines.en: Mother's already asleep. Her research notes are still spread beside the bedside lamp.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我在屋里干坐着嫌闷，就下楼透口气，没打算走远。
lines.en: Sitting inside got stuffy, so I came down for some air. Not going far.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 刚好走到窗前？
lines.en: Just happened by the window?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少得意了，这截柜台台面今晚归我靠一会儿。
lines.en: Don't get smug. This stretch of counter is mine to lean on tonight.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还有，莉迪亚白日里胡扯的那句什么时候，你别往心里去。
lines.en: Also, that "when" nonsense Lydia said today. Don't take it to heart.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那你今晚买什么？
lines.en: So what are you buying tonight?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你这人真是绝了，话还没聊两句就掉头谈生意。
lines.en: You're unbelievable. Two sentences in and you're back to business.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 给我拿几颗营养果，再挑两样耐放的干货。
lines.en: Get me some Nutrifruit, and pick two kinds of dried goods that keep.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲半夜要是醒了容易饿，屋里备着点总归安心。
lines.en: If Mother wakes at night she gets hungry. Better to have something on hand.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你看着拿就行，反正店里的成色你比我清楚。
lines.en: Just pick for me. You know the stock better than I do anyway.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 等一下。
lines.en: Wait.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嫁给我。
lines.en: Marry me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你刚才说什么，有本事再清楚说一遍。
lines.en: ...What did you just say? Say it again, clearly, if you dare.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嫁给我。
lines.en: Marry me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你就隔着这扇破窗口求婚，甚至连手边还放着营养果？
lines.en: You're proposing through this shabby window, with Nutrifruit right by your hand?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以前在上面提亲的人穿得板板正正，满嘴套话说了半天。
lines.en: Suitors up there used to dress so stiffly and spout platitudes for ages.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 结果那些人长什么样，我到现在连一张脸都没记住。
lines.en: And I still can't remember a single one of their faces.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你倒好，统共才蹦出三个字，连柜台上歪着的袋口我都记住了。
lines.en: And you—three words, that's all, and I'll remember even the bag slumped crooked on the counter.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 答不答应？
lines.en: Yes or no?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 催什么催，我又没说要拒绝你。
lines.en: Don't rush me. I never said I'd refuse.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 答应。
lines.en: Yes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （隔窗覆住你的手背）不过先说好，往后我半夜饿了都得归你管。
lines.en: (Covers the back of your hand through the window) But let's be clear: from now on, my midnight hunger is your problem.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 管。
lines.en: Deal.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我本来想现在就上楼告诉母亲，还是等天亮让她睡饱再说吧。
lines.en: I wanted to run upstairs and tell Mother now, but I'll let her sleep till morning.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 求婚归求婚，今晚的营养果和干货照买照算。
lines.en: Proposal or not, tonight's Nutrifruit and dry goods still get rung up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 叫住我又不吭声，干嘛一直拿那种眼神盯着我看？
lines.en: You stop me, then say nothing. Why keep staring at me like that?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 被你看得心跳都乱了，有话赶紧说出来。
lines.en: You've got my heart all out of rhythm. Just say it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 再闷着不说，我可要转身上楼了。
lines.en: Keep stalling and I'm heading upstairs.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你先挑。
lines.en: You pick first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （拿起一颗营养果又放回台面）你从刚才起就一直盯着我瞧。
lines.en: (Picks up a Nutrifruit, then sets it back down) You've been staring at me this whole time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 心里藏着什么话就直说，别拿挑货当幌子。
lines.en: If something's on your mind, say it. Don't hide behind the merchandise.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 刚求完婚做买卖还是老样子，半点都不带含糊的。
lines.en: Just proposed, and business is still business. Not the slightest slip.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 明天我带母亲一块过来，你记得把衣领理平了。
lines.en: I'm bringing Mother tomorrow. Make sure your collar's straight.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这个数明显少收了，你少拿便宜账来哄我。
lines.en: That's clearly undercharging. Don't try to sweet-talk me with cheap math.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我先替你记着，回头拌嘴时再拿出来抵账。
lines.en: I'll keep it on record and cash it in next time we argue.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 好啊，前脚刚求完婚，后脚就开始给我涨价是吧？
lines.en: Oh, nice. Proposal one minute, price hike the next?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 罚你今晚打烊前，把刚才那三个字再多说两遍。
lines.en: Your penalty: before closing, say those three words twice more.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 算了，屋里还剩半袋干粮，足够母亲先顶两天。
lines.en: Never mind. There's half a bag of dry food left—enough to tide Mother over two days.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 明天一早我再跟母亲过来挑。
lines.en: I'll come back with Mother first thing tomorrow to pick.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 打烊前，埃莉诺绕到窗外将手肘支在柜台沿上。
lines.en: Before closing, Eleanor comes around to the window and props her elbows on the counter's edge.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲今晚睡得早，只在屋里留了一盏小灯。
lines.en: Mother went to bed early tonight. She left just one small lamp on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我在屋里干坐着嫌闷，就下楼透口气，没打算走远。
lines.en: Sitting in there was stifling, so I came down for air. Not going far.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 刚好走到窗前？
lines.en: Just happened by the window?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少得意了，这截柜台台面今晚归我靠一会儿。
lines.en: Don't get smug. This stretch of counter is mine to lean on tonight.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还有，莉迪亚白日里胡扯的那句什么时候，你别往心里去。
lines.en: And that "so when?" nonsense Lydia blurted today—don't take it to heart.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那你今晚买什么？
lines.en: So what are you buying tonight?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你这人真是绝了，话还没聊两句就掉头谈生意。
lines.en: Unbelievable. Barely two lines in and you're back to business.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 给我拿几颗营养果，再挑两样耐放的干货。
lines.en: Get me some Nutrifruit, and two kinds of dry goods that keep.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲半夜要是醒了容易饿，屋里备着点总归安心。
lines.en: If Mother wakes at night, she gets hungry. Having something on hand eases my mind.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你看着拿就行，反正店里的成色你比我清楚。
lines.en: Just pick for me. You know your stock better than I do.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 等一下。
lines.en: Wait.

choices.description_en: Let her pick her goods first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 索菲娅拿着划满改痕的纸走到窗前，埃莉诺站在一旁眼角带着亮。
lines.en: Sophia comes to the window with a heavily revised sheet of paper. Eleanor stands beside her, eyes bright.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 天还没亮透，我那床头就有人直勾勾盯着我看了。
lines.en: Before dawn, someone was already at my bedside, staring straight at me.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 恭喜你啊老板，隔着柜台就把这么大的事定下了。
lines.en: Congratulations, shopkeeper. Settling something this big across a counter.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 母亲！我们清早过来明明是为了对采买单的。
lines.en: Mother! We came this early to go over the shopping list!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 单子写好了？
lines.en: List ready?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 屋里缺的碗、桌布和矮凳全都列在上面了。
lines.en: The bowls, tablecloth, and low stools we need are all on it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 母亲起草的时候写了一大片，被我硬生生删改了三遍。
lines.en: Mother's draft went on forever. I cut it down three times.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 咱们那间小屋子就那么大，买多了连下脚的地方都没有。
lines.en: Our place is tiny. Buy too much and there's nowhere to stand.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 删归删，单子上的东西今天全都由我来付钱。
lines.en: Cuts or not, I'm paying for everything on this list today.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你们两个谁都别跟我抢，按店里平时的实价算就行。
lines.en: Neither of you fight me on it. Just charge the usual price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好，听您的。
lines.en: All right. As you say.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 还有宾客名单的事，我们也想听听你的意思。
lines.en: And about the guest list, we'd like your input too.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 除了我和母亲，莉迪亚听到风声肯定也会吵着要来。
lines.en: Besides Mother and me, Lydia will surely beg to come once she hears.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你觉得还要再请谁过来坐坐吗？
lines.en: Is there anyone else you'd like to invite?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 请过道尽头那几户。
lines.en: Invite the families at the end of the corridor.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 老人和带三个孩子那家。
lines.en: The old lady, and the family with three kids.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我就知道你会提他们，前阵子提水时他们也帮过忙。
lines.en: I knew you'd mention them. They helped us carry water a while back.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你记性倒是细，连哪家有几个孩子都挂在心上。
lines.en: You've got a keen memory. You even remember who has how many kids.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 过道那位老太太前两天见了我，还一直念叨你提水的事。
lines.en: The old lady down the corridor saw me the other day. She kept talking about you carrying water.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 隔壁那三个小孩平时最爱闹腾，桌上的糖糕得多备几块。
lines.en: Those three kids next door are always rowdy. We'll need extra sweet cakes on the table.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 还有待客用的饭碗，今天也得挑几只厚实经摔的。
lines.en: And we'll need some sturdy bowls for the guests, ones that won't break.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我前两天刚念叨过一模一样的话，当时你还嫌我操心太多。
lines.en: I said the exact same thing a few days ago, and you said I worry too much.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我那是按实际情况盘算，才不是瞎操心。
lines.en: I'm planning for the actual situation. That's not worrying.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 经摔的碗还有几套。
lines.en: I've got a few sets of sturdy bowls left.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那就连着桌布一块端出来，我今天得挑仔细些。
lines.en: Then bring them out with the tablecloths. I'll choose carefully today.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （轻敲桌面）瓷碗一只只敲过听完声音，没毛病我们再按实价付钱。
lines.en: (Taps the table) We'll tap each bowl and listen. If they're sound, we pay full price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 现在拿给你们看。
lines.en: I'll show you now.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 货都在台面上了。
lines.en: Everything's on the counter.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我先看看成色，挑中了就照店里的老价钱结账。
lines.en: Let me check the quality first. Whatever I pick, we'll pay the shop's usual price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 就请咱们自己人。
lines.en: Just our own people.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 只叫莉迪亚一个人的话，屋里倒确实宽敞不少。
lines.en: If it's only Lydia, the place will feel a lot roomier.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 过道老太太那边也不用挂心，等办完事我装一兜甜食送去。
lines.en: Don't worry about the old lady down the corridor. I'll bring her a bag of sweets afterward.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那今天瓷碗就少拿两只，桌布和矮凳还是照原样挑。
lines.en: Then we'll take two fewer bowls. Same tablecloths and stools as planned.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 名单你们定就好。
lines.en: You two decide the list.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 既然你让我们做主，那就把过道尽头那几户也叫上。
lines.en: Since you're leaving it to us, let's invite the families at the end of the corridor too.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 前阵子停水大家互相照应过，请过来热闹一下也好。
lines.en: Everyone helped each other during the water outage. It'd be nice to have them over.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 碗底厚实布料也密，这钱花得确实踏实。
lines.en: Thick-bottomed bowls, tightly woven cloth. Money well spent.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 算你过关，刚才敲了一遍连只声音发闷的次品都没有。
lines.en: You pass. I tapped every one, and not a single dud.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 明明说好了按实价付，少收的这部分我改天买东西补上。
lines.en: We agreed on full price. I'll make up the difference next time I shop.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 母亲你就别跟他争了，他这人做买卖向来是这副脾气。
lines.en: Don't argue with him, Mother. That's just how he does business.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 趁着家里办喜事抬价，老板这算盘打得可真响。
lines.en: Raising prices during our family's wedding. Quite the scheme, shopkeeper.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 连母亲的钱你都敢多收，等忙完这阵我再跟你慢慢算。
lines.en: You'd overcharge even my mother? Once things settle down, we'll settle this.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 先把单子收起来吧，我们再去旁边的铺子转转。
lines.en: Put the list away for now. We'll check the shops nearby.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 要是别处挑不到经摔的碗，我们回头再来找你。
lines.en: If we can't find sturdy bowls elsewhere, we'll come back to you.

choices.description_en: Invite the households at the end of the corridor.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 索菲娅替埃莉诺拨正颈后的吊坠扣子，指尖轻轻抖了一下。
lines.en: Sophia adjusts the locket clasp at the back of Eleanor's neck. Her fingertips tremble slightly.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲，你的手在抖。
lines.en: Mother, your hand is shaking.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 胡说，我那是今早起来对名单起太早了。
lines.en: Nonsense—I got up too early going over the name list.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 对了，早上农场刚递来信，那批营养果结出活籽了。
lines.en: By the way, word came from the farm this morning—the Nutrifruit batch has viable seeds now.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 往后这下层区自己就能留种，不用只嚼那些干巴果子。
lines.en: Now the Lower Level can keep its own seed instead of just chewing dried-out fruit.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 行了，扣子拨正了，我退开半步，省得挡着你们。
lines.en: All right, clasp's fixed. I'll step back so I'm not in your way.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你听听后排，莉迪亚从刚才进门就一直在擤鼻子。
lines.en: Listen to the back row—Lydia's been sniffling since she walked in.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 明明是我结婚，她哭得倒比谁都响。
lines.en: It's my wedding, yet she's crying louder than anyone.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺转过身站到你面前，抬手替你按平微翘的衣领。
lines.en: Eleanor turns and stands before you, reaching up to smooth your slightly askew collar.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，看清楚了，这身婚服我可只穿这一回。
lines.en: Hey, look closely—I'm only wearing this wedding dress once.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我头一回进你那间破铺子骂的难听话，先给你记在账上。
lines.en: The first time I walked into that rundown shop of yours, I said some ugly things. I'll mark them on the ledger for now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 留着往后哪天吵架了，我们再一笔一笔慢慢翻。
lines.en: Save them for the next time we fight, and we'll go through them line by line.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以后的日子我们搭伙过，两边的账并作一本算。
lines.en: We'll live the days ahead together—two ledgers kept as one.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就算哪天还得吃难吃的营养果，也一人一句轮流骂。
lines.en: Even if we're stuck eating awful Nutrifruit someday, we'll take turns cursing it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这笔不退不换的长久买卖，你认不认？
lines.en: This long-term deal—no returns, no exchanges—do you accept?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我愿意。
lines.en: I do.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 说定了就快着点，过道的老太太和小孩攥着的喜糖都快捂化了。
lines.en: If we're agreed, hurry—the old woman and kids in the aisle are clutching wedding candy that's about to melt.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 化了就再发一把，今天谁也别想催我。
lines.en: If it melts, hand out more. No one's rushing me today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 让他们多等一会儿……我还没看够呢。
lines.en: Let them wait a little longer... I haven't had my fill of looking.

lines.speaker: SEC

lines.speaker: Eleanor

lines.en: We only invited family—how is Lydia in the back row crying louder than ten people?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 早知道刚才多给她塞两块手帕了。

lines.en: Once it's settled, let's start the feast. Tomorrow I'll bag the thank-you sweets for the households down the corridor and deliver them.

lines.en: What's the rush? It's just us in here. No one gets to rush me.
